name: 10015 Tools

sources.title: 10015.io homepage - all-in-one online tools site hosting 'Product Finder' directory
Submit your product - URL-driven submission form with pricing FAQ

conditions: Free submission is allowed but joins a standard review queue of 3-4 months
Priority review is a one-time $9.99 fee for listing within 24 hours
Free listings get a NOFOLLOW link — a Google-indexed page with a dofollow backlink requires the featured upgrade (from $2.99/month)
requirements: Accepts products, tools, SaaS, mobile and desktop apps, browser extensions, add-ons — 'anything with a live website'
Every submission passes a manual quality review before publication
Submission starts by entering the product URL — the site auto-fetches page data to pre-fill the form, so the target page must be fetchable
preparation: Canonical product URL with good title/meta (the form scrapes it for pre-fill)
Category selection (Productivity, Development, Design, Marketing, Business, Finance, AI, Social Media, Lifestyle) and tags
Images/description to review in the pre-filled form
Contact email for the 'your product is live' notification
workflow: Open https://10015.io/product-finder/submit/ ('Submit' on the Product Finder page)
Enter the product URL — site data is fetched and used to pre-fill the submission form
Review the pre-filled fields, choose categories and tags, and submit
Optionally purchase the $9.99 priority review right after submitting to skip the 3-4 month queue
Wait for the email confirming the product is live
To update the listing later, email support (per FAQ: reach out with changes)
watchFor: Free-tier trap: the free listing link is explicitly NOFOLLOW — the catalog's 'link=follow' assumption does not hold on the free route; dofollow requires featured ($2.99/mo)
3-4 month free review queue — the $9.99 priority-review upsell is offered immediately after submitting
Auto-fetch pre-fill means a missing/weak title or og:description on your page produces a weak listing
Site requires JavaScript to display properly
Updates are manual via email, not a self-serve dashboard
countsAsLive: A public product card/page appears on 10015.io/product-finder/ and in its category/tag pages, with a Visit link to the product
unknowns: Exact form fields beyond the URL entry (pre-fill flow)
Whether the $9.99 priority review also changes link type to dofollow or only the monthly featured plan does
Rejection criteria for the manual quality review
